messages.subject: Saudi Arabia / UAE Executive Leadership | Strategy, Government Relations, ESG and Country Operations
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Puri,

Your Middle East search work across strategy, government and public sector, energy and sustainability, and senior leadership in Saudi Arabia and the UAE makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current role sits where executive leadership, ministries, regulators, communities, investment priorities, energy transition and complex operating environments intersect.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates. I am particularly interested in government-linked, industrial, infrastructure, energy and transformation environments where institutional engagement and cross-functional execution matter.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming senior searches aligned with this profile. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
